description: The plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of different model configurations from the Mixture of Hidden-Dimensions Transformer as a function of the activated parameters ratio, expressed as a percentage on the x-axis, which ranges from 100% to 25% in decreasing steps (100, 75, 50, 25) and is plotted on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL,” ranges from 11.5 to 14.0 in increments of 0.5 and is also linear. Four configurations are compared: “Transformer” (dashed red line with no markers) remains nearly flat across all sparsity levels, hovering around 11.6; “Only MoHD FFN” (solid gray line with square markers) starts at approximately 11.6 at 100% and rises slightly to 11.8 at 25%; “Only MoHD ATTN” (solid dark blue line with circular markers) begins at 11.6 at 100%, dips slightly to 11.5 at 75%, then sharply increases to 12.3 at 50% and further to 14.0 at 25%; and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (solid cyan line with cross markers) starts at 11.6 at 100%, rises to 11.7 at 75%, then climbs to 12.1 at 50%, and reaches 13.1 at 25%. All lines show increasing perplexity as sparsity increases (i.e., as activated parameters decrease), with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest degradation at lower parameter ratios.
